steps.title: follow the lowest note
steps.body:
Push players voice chords densely, so the top of the chord won't tell you its root. Follow the **lowest** note instead.

- The drill plays drums and bass only.
- Play each chord's bass note on the keyboard, Field keys or touch, any octave.
- After each chord the reveal names it as a degree of the key: `1`, `b3`, `4`, `5`, `b6`, `b7`…

This loop is E minor, three chords. Hum the bass before you play it.
